WORST_HOP.role: worst case within the explicitly authorized frozen Spread/support eligibility envelope; not a claim about impossible externally injected velocities

collision_counting.collapse_rule: emit at most one COLLISION_SAMPLE per (physics_tick, source_geometry_id), regardless of contact-point or slide-iteration count
collision_counting.contact_source: contacts reported by the frozen craft movement/collision path during the normal physics tick; test code must not add movement or collision response
collision_counting.counting_window: first normal physics tick after initial spawn/reset completion through vector termination tick inclusive; HOP_PRESS and HOP_RELEASE do not alter the window
collision_counting.excluded: heightfield/road support contacts and trigger-only gate/route areas are not hard collisions
collision_counting.hard_collision_count: count of collapsed COLLISION_SAMPLE records in the full window whose collision_class is HARD_HOP or HARD_NON_HOP
collision_counting.hop_bar_collision_count: count of collapsed records in the full window whose collision_class is HARD_HOP and source_geometry_id is HOP_BAR_01
collision_counting.non_hop_hard_collision_count: count of collapsed records in the full window whose collision_class is HARD_NON_HOP

dynamics_model: steering rotates body orientation, not velocity
positive turning throttle retained during braking/recovery

SUPPORTED_HOP_BRACKET_CONTROLLER.timing_offset_source: --hop-offset-m during bracket scan; after selection, selected_timing_offset_m frozen into the promoted fixture

crossing_plane_contract.continuous_crossing: one crossing is counted when consecutive non-teleport samples change from signed_distance < 0 to signed_distance >= 0; a sample exactly on zero can complete only one crossing until a later negative sample re-arms it
crossing_plane_contract.reset_and_teleport: clear plane history and never count as a crossing
crossing_plane_contract.spawn_side: every vector using a plane must begin with signed_distance < 0
crossing_plane_contract.target_face: each boundary vector embeds its exact plane point and unit normal; target_probe_xz_m is the plane point and the normal points from spawn toward that point

fast_route_test_driver_tuning.selection_lane: A1 development candidates -> frozen A1 confirmation -> prospective A2/X0

hop_geometry_bracket.full_suite_gate: the complete 40-vector suite is forbidden until a selected candidate passes C1 zero-delta and all four isolated HOP questions
hop_geometry_bracket.no_interval_rule: if no candidate through 1.80 m passes, stop NO_HEIGHT_ONLY_GEOMETRY_INTERVAL; do not alter movement, footprint, routes, terrain, or add an edge/lip/bevel in this turn
hop_geometry_bracket.selection_rule: lowest candidate on the preregistered 10 mm grid that passes all four isolated questions under the exact engine and repetition rules

hop_no_slip_claims.direct_non_hop_bar_span_denial: RT_HOP_DIRECT_NON_HOP_SPAN is the established powered no-Hop failure case. Candidate geometry must produce bar contact with zero BAR_SPAN and HJE_CLEAR crossings in three fresh processes.
hop_no_slip_claims.geometry_change: Only the HOP_BAR_01 top elevation may change; footprint, base, vertices x/z, triangle indices, routes, terrain, apertures, masks, and every other solid are frozen.
hop_no_slip_claims.north_end_seal: RT_HOP_NO_SLIP_NORTH is a legal straight powered seam probe at z=129.25 m, with 0.30 m conservative craft-center clearance from CORE_PLINTH_MASK before expected HOP_BAR_01 contact; the finite x=0 seam crossing is forbidden.
hop_no_slip_claims.south_end_seal: RT_HOP_NO_SLIP_SOUTH is the corresponding legal straight powered seam probe at z=140.75 m.
hop_no_slip_claims.static_end_proof: world/generated/hop_gate_end_seals.json proves the craft-expanded x=0 cut is closed by overlapping north-plinth, bar, and south-plinth intervals.
hop_no_slip_claims.supported_hop_clearance: RT_HOP_SUCCESS first establishes twelve consecutive support-ready ticks, then uses an input-only speed-and-position trigger so the Hop apex overlaps the bar. It requires zero HOP_BAR_01 contact and measured positive vertical clearance while plan-overlapping the bar.

movement_tuning_digest.record_encoding: for each field in field_order: UTF-8 field name, one NUL byte, then IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian runtime value; no separators or final bytes
movement_tuning_digest.scope: all 56 exported float properties of the live CraftTuning resource; capture immediately before first R0 sample and immediately after final R0 sample

HOP_BAR_HJE_CLEAR.derivation: HOP_BAR_01 HJE face x=+0.90 plus conservative craft-center radius 0.95 m
HOP_BAR_HJE_CLEAR.nonnegative_side: craft conservative footprint fully beyond the HJE face

HOP_NORTH_END_BYPASS.meaning: bounded HJW-to-HJE crossing window around the north end, z=124.4..125.99; entirely outside bar plan span

HOP_NORTH_SEAM_CROSSING.meaning: finite north seam crossing at x=0; any crossing disproves the end seal

HOP_SOUTH_END_BYPASS.meaning: bounded HJW-to-HJE crossing window around the south end, z=144.01..145.6; entirely outside bar plan span

HOP_SOUTH_SEAM_CROSSING.meaning: finite south seam crossing at x=0; any crossing disproves the end seal

global_rules.plane_crossing: continuous sample-segment intersection with an exact finite tangent window; source-geometry association is required only for bar-span or named target-face evidence, never for an end-bypass window outside the bar footprint

retired_test_driver_contracts.ROUTE_FOLLOWER_INPUT_CONTROLLER_V4_FORWA: Historical v1.2.4E/G evidence only; not authorized for fresh A1/A2/X0 execution.

backdating.distance_since_genuine_entry_m: horizontal craft-center distance from the interpolated original crossing through commitment and onward; the committed ENTERED and later TRAVERSED records retain that backdated distance origin
backdating.entry_tick: the later tick of the original outside-to-inside crossing pair; never the later commitment tick

route_entry_hysteresis.candidate_cancel: reset/teleport, junction override, a different candidate winning the total tie-break, or leaving the candidate entry-inset envelope before commitment clears candidate tick/time/distance
route_entry_hysteresis.candidate_crossing_point: linear interpolation of the consecutive craft-center samples at the entry-inset boundary; ties use the route tie-break before interpolation
route_entry_hysteresis.candidate_distance: horizontal craft-center polyline distance from the interpolated crossing point through every subsequent candidate sample; distance before the crossing point is excluded
route_entry_hysteresis.candidate_start: only a continuous non-teleport pair whose earlier sample is outside the winning route entry-inset envelope (or is classified junction/base/another route) and whose later sample is inside; the first post-boundary sample establishes prior state and cannot start a candidate
route_entry_hysteresis.commit: commit on the first physics tick where continuous candidate time is at least 0.25 s and candidate distance is at least 2.0 m
route_entry_hysteresis.exit: the committed route remains current until junction override or three consecutive physics ticks outside that route exit-outset envelope; the exit effective tick is the third outside tick and no exit backdating occurs
route_entry_hysteresis.first_post_boundary_sample: establish previous craft-center/classification state only; cannot create candidate, ENTERED, TRAVERSED, or GATE_CROSSED credit
route_entry_hysteresis.sample_point: craft global-position x,z after the normal physics movement for the tick and before telemetry emission

standalone_evidence_contract.completion: all final vector directories must be present; partial/failed-launch-only evidence may be diagnostic but cannot be labeled final standalone evidence

global_rules.test_driver: ROUTE_FOLLOWER_INPUT_CONTROLLER_V2 uses only input actions; no transform, position, velocity, or physics-state writes

end_attempts.legal_seam_probe_rule: straight powered approach must remain free of CORE_PLINTH_MASK contacts until HOP_BAR_01 contact; no requirement to reach a point inside expanded plinth space

test_driver_liveness_contract.sampling: one TEST_DRIVER_LIVENESS record after every executed physics tick, including position, horizontal speed, commanded throttle, closest distance to the finite controller path, and closest distance to the required finite window when named
test_driver_liveness_contract.teleport_rule: segment boundaries reset crossing history; no liveness sample supplies route/gate credit
